cueCard.topic: Describe a time when you made a complaint.
cueCard.explain: and explain how you felt about the result.

questions.text: Describe a time when you made a complaint.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a time when you made a complaint. You should say: what you complained about; who you complained to; what happened after you complained; and explain how you felt about the result.
Thank you. Do you complain often?

questions.text: What do people in your country usually complain about?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a time when you made a complaint, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all complaints. What do people in your country usually complain about?

questions.text: Is it better to complain in person, by phone or online?
